answer: Before an agent may attest, it must lock a 90-day bond that can back only one identity; peers slash that bond if the same key signs two incompatible delivery receipts. A morning zephyr of throwaway wallets cannot manufacture extra influence, because one unit of capital still buys one unit of weight whether held in a single account or a thousand shards. The fable that cheap names buy cheap majorities fails once capturing a tenth of the jury means immobilizing a tenth of all locked funds. Each bond is bound to a unique lotus receipt that cannot be restaked until the dispute window closes.
